variants.short: no ready VMs in the pool
variants.L0: The VM pool has no ready VM

L1.what: Nothing is ready to lease, and the pool is meant to keep spare VMs warm.
L1.why: Anyone who asks for a VM now waits for one to be built to order, which takes minutes.

variants.how: Open the Pool tab on the Proxmox page. Check the lanes have room and no build is failing; raise the lane limit or warm target if demand has grown.

L1.what: Several VM builds in a row failed on {lane}. Last error: {last_error|"none recorded"}
L1.why: The pool cannot warm spare VMs there, so leases fall back to slow made-to-order builds or fail.

variants.how: Ask me to look at the pool log for {lane}; check the template and the host are healthy.

variants.L0: VM {vmid} is past its lease and could not be removed

L1.what: The lease on VM {vmid} for {lessee|"someone"} ran out and the clean-up could not destroy it.
L1.why: It keeps using CPU, memory and disk on {node|"its host"} until it is removed.

variants.how: Release it from the Pool tab, or ask me why the destroy is failing (often an approval is waiting).

variants.short: VM pool paused, waiting on an approval
variants.L0: The VM pool is paused, waiting on an approval

L1.what: A host command the pool needs was not covered by a standing grant, so it filed an approval and stopped warming.
L1.why: No new VMs are built until it is approved or the lane gets a standing grant, so the spare VMs run down.

variants.how: Approve it in Approvals, or give the lane a standing grant so it does not ask again.

variants.L0: The VM pool has a note
